title: Learning Pathology-Sensitive Representations for Unsupervised Retinal OCT Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning approaches for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) predominantly rely on predefined disease categories, limiting their ability to detect rare or previously unseen abnormalities. While visual foundation models provide transferable representations, their effectiveness in identifying pathological deviations from normal retinal anatomy remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce an unsupervised framework for retinal OCT anomaly detection and localization that adapts pretrained visual representations to normal retinal anatomy through anatomy-aware reconstruction and contrastive triplet learning guided by synthetic structural perturbations, without requiring disease-specific annotations. We systematically investigate the influence of pretraining strategies, anatomy-aware representation adaptation, and anomaly scoring mechanisms on the detection and localization of unseen retinal abnormalities. translated_title: 面向无监督视网膜OCT异常检测的病理敏感表征学习
translated_abstract: 用于视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）的深度学习方法主要依赖于预定义的疾病类别，这限制了它们检测罕见或先前未见异常的能力。虽然视觉基础模型提供了可迁移的表征，但它们在识别正常视网膜解剖结构中的病理偏差方面的有效性仍不够明确。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个用于视网膜OCT异常检测与定位的无监督框架，该框架通过解剖感知重建和由合成结构扰动引导的对比三元组学习，将预训练的视觉表征适配到正常视网膜解剖结构上，而无需疾病特定标注。我们系统地研究了预训练策略、解剖感知表征适配和异常评分机制对未见过的视网膜异常检测与定位的影响。我们的发现……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需疾病标注的无监督视网膜OCT异常检测与定位框架，通过解剖感知重建和合成结构扰动引导的对比三元组学习，将预训练视觉表征适配到正常视网膜解剖结构，从而实现对罕见及未知视网膜异常的检测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an unsupervised framework for retinal OCT anomaly detection and localization that adapts pretrained visual representations to normal retinal anatomy through anatomy-aware reconstruction and contrastive triplet learning guided by synthetic structural perturbations, enabling detection of rare and unseen retinal abnormalities without disease-specific annotations.
